carbs.title: Carbohydrates
carbs.description: Carbohydrates are an important nutrient as they supply our main source of energy.  Carbohydrates from food are broken down into a sugar in our blood called glucose. Our brain and central nervous system utilise glucose as a primary energy source so it's important we have a continued supply!  Glucose is also a great fuel for our muscles and is needed for exercise and sports. There are three main types of carbohydrates:Sugars - Find out more about sugar by clicking on the salt & sugar tile.StarchStarchy foods are our main source of carbohydrate. It is important to include them in our diets as they provide us with energy, and they can help improve our gut health. Many starchy foods are nutritious as they are good sources of vitamins, minerals and fibre.Some starchy foods include:FibreFoods that contain fibre are highly nutritious as they contain many important vitamins and minerals.
